subject: Agriculture
title: Rural Inequality
description: Learn Rural Inequality in one minute.

hook.text: The Green Revolution boosted production—but the benefits weren't shared equally.

buildup.text: Farmers with land, water, and capital adopted quickly. Landless laborers and tiny plot holders could not.

discovery.text: Wealthier farmers bought neighbors' land. Farm sizes grew at the top while small holders were squeezed out.

twist.text: In many regions, the gap between rich and poor farmers widened during the yield boom, not narrowed.

climax.text: Rural migration to cities accelerated as small-scale farming became uncompetitive.

punchline.text: More food for everyone. More wealth for some.

quiz.question: How did the Green Revolution affect rural inequality?
options: It often widened the gap between wealthy farmers and landless laborers
It had no effect on inequality
